obligations.claim: Actual fixed three-coordinate rational matrix model
obligations.reason: The real/imaginary spatial dictionary is an explicit linear equivalence with the three vector coordinates. Matrix operators, casts and multiplication are proved equal to the actual P75 operator, not abstract substitutes.

obligations.claim: Exact affine mass row and dense rational transforms
obligations.reason: Only the six lower-row entries vary, so rational approximation preserves the first row [1,0,0] exactly. The density result is the actual iterated coordinatewise rational dense range on Fin2 times Fin3.

The atlas inverse is actual Matrix.nonsing_inv and both inverse laws use det-unit witnesses. Rational and real inverses agree by multiplication/inverse uniqueness. Coefficient conjugation equals the entire inverse-conjugated polynomial, and continuity is derived at an actual invertible transform.

obligations.claim: One strict neighborhood over every normalized input and observation
obligations.reason: Joint continuity is on the transform, real observation and complex spatial input. Compactness applies to Icc[-1,1] times the closed unit disk. The resulting neighborhood controls every point; evaluating the actual attained worstInput yields the strict sigma inequality. No finite sampling of the input ball is substituted.

obligations.claim: Positive rational margin and rational witness existence are derived
obligations.reason: A rational kappa is chosen strictly between zero and the supplied positive real uniform margin. Finite intersections retain all families/actions/initials and nonsingular determinant. Rational density selects a single actual mass-preserving transform inside that neighborhood. Initial slack, determinant and full operator margin then follow for the selected rational transform.

obligations.claim: Proof-free finite certificate descriptions and complete coverage
obligations.reason: Data consist only of natural degrees, finite rational arrays, and all four children at each positive grid depth. leafValid checks every coefficient sign and equality of the actual finitely supported local polynomial with the literal tensor polynomial. The iff identifies exactly those submitted data with a genuine uniform certificate; arrays cannot omit a chart, test, child or polynomial identity.

obligations.claim: Concrete finite checker, without a desired-existence oracle
obligations.reason: The Decidable builders unfold the finite checks and synthesize their rational sign, finite universal and polynomial equality instances. They introduce no Classical.propDecidable instance, no generic noncomputable proposition-decider, and no witness-existence or semantic positivity premise. MvPolynomial equality ultimately compares finitely supported polynomial data; the pinned Finsupp instance compares finite supports and their coefficients.

obligations.claim: Actual decoded dovetail search and stable eventual return
obligations.reason: The countable candidate representation has an actual Encodable instance. step checks Encodable.decode k; complete decoding at encode a reaches every accepted finite description. The recursive scan retains the first accepted candidate, soundness checks that returned candidate, and search_add proves it remains the return at larger budgets. Eventual success is derived from an existing accepted description without an enumeration-completeness field.

obligations.claim: Strict real hypothesis supplies the accepted finite candidate
obligations.reason: The rational-sector theorem supplies an actual rational transform and strict positive gap. P75 strict_family_eventual provides one common depth for every finite family/action and both tests in both charts. Extracting proof-free finite descriptions yields Valid, and the decoded search theorem yields finite eventual stable acceptance. No assumed certificate-existence/completeness field closes this step.

obligations.claim: Mass and independent strict initial checks are retained
obligations.reason: Exact integrated mass of the original submitted families and mass-one rational initials remain explicit, legitimate source assumptions. Inverse-conjugation mass transport is proved algebraically using both the transform and inverse mass rows. Initial cone membership uses its separate rational StrictVector test rather than being inferred from operator tests.

obligations.claim: Same complete-family and independent initial hulls have actual law validity
obligations.reason: P75 certificate margins and exact transported mass establish P76 feasible for the actual returned coefficient arrays. P76 convexity preserves that feasibility over the complete-family hull; the independent initial hull lies in the same normalized base. These actual arrays construct a DensityInstrument and its actual P52 record law is a probability measure at every finite horizon. The candidate in the search conclusion is the same one used in these constructions.

obligations.claim: Original source hull is sound on the same returned actual atlas
obligations.reason: The full source coefficient family transforms by a proved linear map, so the original real convex hull maps into exactly the returned transformed hull. The actual inverse supplies the polynomial action identity. The original hull operators preserve the actual pullback Lorentz cone and the original initial hull lies in its base; no different convenient family or geometry is substituted.

scope: The result is conditional on a real invertible mass-preserving atlas, strictly interior supplied initials and a positive common actual full margin. It supplies no termination guarantee at zero margin or boundary initials.

The formal search is theoretical countable semidecision through explicit finite rational/sign/polynomial comparisons. Pinned mathlib MvPolynomial operations and affine substitution are represented noncomputably. No Lean-VM extracted runtime checker, fixed search budget, complexity bound, implemented general optimizer, or statistical coverage is asserted.

returned_hull_probability states the actual probability law for the transformed hull. The source hull is tied to that same family and certified directly on its actual atlas cone/base. This review does not add an unstated theorem asserting literal equality between separately constructed original and transformed recordLaw objects.

All finite polynomial families are represented with a common finite coefficient index, allowing ordinary zero padding for differing degrees. No independent optimization of geometry and family coefficients is asserted.
